title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Amounts Taken at Booking, Held at Collection and Returned
content:
What a renter pays before collection, what is held against their card and how long a settlement takes are all class amounts. The six Car Rental Rate Classes carry them as follows.

| Rate class | Agency service fee (USD) | Prepaid in full | Prepayment share (percent) | Deposit hold (USD) | Currency conversion markup (percent) | Refund processing (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 14.95 | yes | 100 | 500.00 | 3.5 | 0 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 12.95 | yes | 100 | 400.00 | 3.5 | 14 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 9.95 | no | 0 | 350.00 | 3 | 10 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 9.95 | no | 0 | 250.00 | 2.5 | 7 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0.00 | no | 0 | 150.00 | 2 | 5 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 0.00 | no | 0 | 300.00 | 2 | 10 |

The agency service fee is the agency booking service fee charged once per rental. The prepaid column records whether the whole rental is taken at booking rather than at the counter, and the prepayment share is the percentage of the rental total taken at booking. The deposit hold is the amount held on the renter's card at collection and released at return. The conversion markup is the percentage added when the renter elects to be charged in a currency other than the supplier's own. The refund processing column is the number of business days the settlement of an approved refund takes.

**Where the columns move together.** Only the Pay Now Saver Rate and the Pay Now Standard Rate are prepaid, and both take 100 percent at booking; the other four take 0 percent. The deposit hold falls as the class rises, from 500 on the Pay Now Saver Rate to 150 on the Premium Inclusive Rate, with the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate at 300. The agency service fee runs 14.95, 12.95, 9.95, 9.95, 0 and 0 across the six classes in rank order. Settlement takes no business days at all on the Pay Now Saver Rate, and between 5 and 14 business days on the other five.
